$comment: The shadcn registry: what each item ships. scripts/build-registry.mjs derives dependencies from the files' imports and writes public/r/*.json; the site reads the same list for the example pages' source tabs and titles.

items.name: tip
items.title: Tip
items.description: A coss tooltip around any element, used by the trawlnet builder's actions.

items.name: query-builder
items.title: Query builder (coss ui)
items.description: A complete trawlnet query builder made of coss ui components: typed fields, value/field/function operands, list conditions, locks, drag and drop, undo-ready.
items.docs: Render <CossQueryBuilder store={store} /> from @/components/trawlnet/query-builder with a store from createQueryStore() (@trawlnet/core).

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: A copyable code block in a content-sized coss scroll area.

items.name: describe
items.title: Describe a query
items.description: Render a trawlnet query as a plain-English sentence with the text codec.

items.name: example-utils
items.title: Example helpers
items.description: useExampleStore, useLiveQuery and a seeded random generator, shared by the trawlnet examples.

items.name: linear-filters
items.title: Linear-style filter bar
items.description: Inline filter chips: the same hooks, a completely different UI

items.name: workflow
items.title: Workflow automation triggers
items.description: “When a booking is created and …, then …” with a live event log

items.name: saved-views
items.title: Saved views & undo
items.description: Named views, dirty tracking, undo/redo, and queries as plain English

items.name: product-filters
items.title: E-commerce product filters
items.description: Faceted search over a catalogue, filtered client-side with compile()

items.name: segments
items.title: CRM audience segments
items.description: Marketing segments with a live audience count and parameterized SQL

items.name: feature-flags
items.title: Feature-flag targeting
items.description: Segment rules + percentage rollout, shipped to the edge as JsonLogic

items.name: alerting
items.title: Monitoring alert rules
items.description: Thresholds, ranges and field-vs-field checks over a live metric stream

items.name: access-policy
items.title: Access-control policies

items.title: Drop-in for react-querybuilder

items.title: One query, every backend
items.description: The same query as Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB and JsonLogic
